notes.title: Exciting Game Update: Regions & Key Rebinding!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
- One of the most requested features from our players has been key rebinding, and we are pleased to announce that this feature has now been added to the game. You can now customize your controls and play the game the way you want, with the keys that you prefer. This new feature will make your gameplay experience more personalized and enjoyable.
NOTE: Key re-binding in possible in the Main Menu -> Settings

- We are also pleased to announce a another game update that addresses the region connectivity issues that have been in the game mainly for server balancing and latency reasons. 
We have now removed this feature and are now happy to announce that all players are connecting to the same server and are now in the same room, regardless of their location. This means that players from different continents can now play together seamlessly.
Please not that due to this requested feature from the community, latency will go up for player connecting to the lobby from outside the US.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42679622/736c1d0a2111c7b5211bd379da3d830e10d6d5fa.png

NEXT TO COME:

We're also working on full controller support currently. We understand that many players prefer to use a controller when playing games and we want to make sure that everyone can have the best experience possible. Full controller support will be added shortly, so stay tuned!

In addition to these improvements, we're also working on a pure single player mode. We know that some of our players prefer to play solo, so we want to make sure that you can have the best experience possible whether you're playing with friends or on your own. This mode will be added in the near future, so keep an eye out for it.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy these updates. If you have any questions or feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out. We're always here to help.

Best regards,
WASD Games

notes.title: New Game Update is Live! [Matchmaking and Connectivity]
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Doggo Estates has just received the first game update, what is expected to be one of many on the road from Early Access to Full Release.

The Game version changes from 0.0.4 to 0.0.5.

Update:
- This game update mainly focuses on matchmaking and connectivity while in lobby. The matchmaking should now be processed faster and should completely eliminate the issue which some players reported of having when they were unable to connect when re-joining a new session.
Before, the players needed to leave the lobby after they finished a game and rejoin the lobby in order to see the new lobby updates. With this update, these issues should be resolved and players can remain in the lobby to receive updates.

- Connectivity should also be now resolved, where players joined the room on a high ping they sometimes started the game a few seconds later than other players with low ping did. This update addresses this issues and recalibrates the waiting time for all players depending on individual pings of all players, this way a fair-start to the game is guaranteed for all players.

Furthermore, we are currently developing the single player mode, which and also working on key re-bindings and controller support.

Many thanks,
WASD Games
